_readme: THE PHYSICS SAMPLE PAPER — edit this file to change what the Milliy sertifikat
physics builder's "Namunaviy variant" button loads. Contract: docs/MILLIY_QUIZ.md.
WHY 35 QUESTIONS / 100 MINUTES. ⚠️ Unlike maths, NO published physics blueprint
is encoded in this repo (maths has EXAM_BLUEPRINT; nothing equivalent exists
here), so this length is THIS FILE'S OWN, not a national spec — it matches the
`fizika` defaults in MILLIY_SUBJECTS so pressing the button fills the builder
to exactly its target. A teacher who wants another length changes the target
and edits the paper; nothing is enforced against a protocol that does not exist.
THE DISTRIBUTION THIS FILE FOLLOWS, one line per taxonomy topic:
mexanika                        12  (kinematika 4 - dinamika 3 - saqlanish 4 - statika 1)
molekulyar-fizika-va-termodinamika  6
elektr-va-magnetizm              8
optika-va-nisbiylik-nazariyasi   5
kvant-va-yadro-fizikasi          4
→ 35 slots: 30 closed (Y-1) + 5 short typed (O)
⚠️ NOTHING ENFORCES THAT. The builder has no per-section quotas (by design —
see checkMilliyAdd), so the counts above are this file's own discipline.
Recount them by hand if you add or remove an entry.
Per entry:
topicId     a `fizika` TOPIC slug. It becomes the item's sectionId, which is
what the teacher's results page groups by. The taxonomy keeps the
five classical branches and nothing finer:
mexanika
molekulyar-fizika-va-termodinamika
elektr-va-magnetizm
optika-va-nisbiylik-nazariyasi
kvant-va-yadro-fizikasi
subtopicId  optional, for a more precise label. Must belong to its topic.
Physics subtopics carry a "Group — Leaf" prefix, so they read
e.g. `dinamika-elastiklik-kuchi-guk-qonuni`.
question    a string, or {uz, ru, en}. A bare string is used for all three.
options     A-D (OptionKey is A..D). PRESENT => closed item; ABSENT => typed
item. There is no separate flag, so the two cannot contradict.
answer      closed -> the correct option key; typed -> the literal answer.
acceptedAnswers  typed only: other spellings graded correct.
numeric     typed only, default FALSE. ⚠️ SET IT TRUE on every calculation
answer — like chemistry, every typed answer here is a number, and
numeric grading normalizes `0,2` / `0.2` / spacing so a right
answer is never marked wrong for formatting.
explanation shown on the results screen when the teacher left answers visible.
difficultyId 1 easy - 2 medium - 3 hard (default 2).
⚠️ FORMULAS ARE PLAIN TEXT (v = at, E = mc², 6,6·10⁻³⁴), never LaTeX. These
strings run through the same LatexRenderer as every other question, so a stray
`$`, `_` or `^` would be read as math and render as garbage.
⚠️ AUTHORED UZBEK-ONLY: a bare string fills ru and en with the same text, so a
student who picked Russian sees Uzbek rather than a blank. Add {uz, ru, en}
objects per entry as translations are made.

questions.question: Avtomobil 72 km/soat tezlik bilan harakatlanmoqda. Uning SI birliklaridagi tezligi qancha?
Tinch holatdan 2 m/s² tezlanish bilan harakatlanayotgan jism 5 s da qancha yo'l bosadi?
questions.explanation: Boshlang'ich tezlik nolga teng: s = at²/2 = 2·25/2 = 25 m.

questions.question: 20 m balandlikdan erkin tushayotgan jism yerga qanday tezlik bilan uriladi? (g = 10 m/s²)
Ikki poyezd bir-biriga qarab 20 m/s va 15 m/s tezlik bilan harakatlanmoqda. Ularning bir-biriga nisbatan tezligi qancha?
questions.explanation: Qarama-qarshi yo'nalishdagi harakatda nisbiy tezlik tezliklar yig'indisiga teng: 20 + 15 = 35 m/s.

questions.question: Massasi 4 kg jismga 12 N kuch ta'sir qilsa, u qanday tezlanish oladi?
questions.explanation: Nyutonning ikkinchi qonuni: a = F/m = 12/4 = 3 m/s².

questions.question: Bikrligi 200 N/m bo'lgan prujinani 5 sm ga cho'zish uchun qanday kuch kerak?
questions.explanation: Guk qonuni: F = kx. x = 5 sm = 0,05 m, F = 200·0,05 = 10 N.

questions.question: Massasi 10 kg jism gorizontal sirt bo'ylab siljitilmoqda. Ishqalanish koeffitsienti 0,2 bo'lsa, ishqalanish kuchi qancha? (g = 10 m/s²)
Massasi 2 kg jism 5 m/s tezlik bilan harakatlanmoqda. Uning impulsi necha kg·m/s ga teng? Javobni son bilan yozing.
Massasi 4 kg jism 10 m/s tezlik bilan harakatlanmoqda. Uning kinetik energiyasi qancha?
10 N kuch jismni o'z yo'nalishida 5 m ko'chirdi. Bajarilgan ish qancha?
questions.explanation: A = F·s·cos α, α = 0 bo'lgani uchun A = 10·5 = 50 J.

questions.question: Mexanik energiyaning saqlanish qonuni qaysi shartda bajariladi?

options.B: Ishqalanish va qarshilik kuchlari hisobga olinmaganda
options.D: Har qanday holatda, hech qanday shartsiz

questions.explanation: Yopiq sistemada faqat konservativ kuchlar ish bajarganda kinetik va potensial energiyalar yig'indisi o'zgarmaydi; ishqalanish energiyaning bir qismini ichki energiyaga aylantiradi.

questions.question: Hajmi 0,002 m³ bo'lgan jism suvga to'liq botirilgan. Unga ta'sir etuvchi Arximed kuchi qancha? (ρ = 1000 kg/m³, g = 10 m/s²)
Normal sharoitda 44,8 l ideal gaz necha mol moddani tashkil etadi?
questions.explanation: Normal sharoitda 1 mol gaz 22,4 l hajmni egallaydi: 44,8 : 22,4 = 2 mol.

questions.question: Ideal gazning holat tenglamasi (Mendeleyev va Klapeyron tenglamasi) qaysi ko'rinishda yoziladi?
questions.explanation: Modda miqdori n = m/M bo'lgani uchun pV = nRT = (m/M)RT.

questions.question: Izotermik jarayonda gazning bosimi 2 marta orttirilsa, hajmi qanday o'zgaradi?
questions.explanation: Boyl va Mariott qonuni: pV = const, demak bosim 2 marta ortsa hajm 2 marta kamayadi.

questions.question: Gazga 500 J issiqlik berildi va u 200 J ish bajardi. Gazning ichki energiyasi necha joulga o'zgardi? Javobni son bilan yozing.
questions.explanation: Termodinamikaning birinchi qonuni: ΔU = Q − A = 500 − 200 = 300 J.

questions.question: 2 kg suvni 10 °C ga isitish uchun qancha issiqlik miqdori kerak? (c = 4200 J/(kg·°C))
Havoning nisbiy namligi 100% ga teng bo'lsa, bu nimani bildiradi?
questions.explanation: Nisbiy namlik — havodagi bug' bosimining shu haroratdagi to'yingan bug' bosimiga nisbati. 100% da bug' to'yingan bo'ladi va shudring tusha boshlaydi.

questions.question: Ikki nuqtaviy zaryad orasidagi masofa 2 marta orttirilsa, ular orasidagi o'zaro ta'sir kuchi qanday o'zgaradi?
questions.explanation: Kulon qonunida kuch masofa kvadratiga teskari proporsional: masofa 2 marta ortsa kuch 4 marta kamayadi.

questions.question: Qarshiligi 20 Ω bo'lgan o'tkazgich uchlariga 10 V kuchlanish berildi. Undagi tok kuchi qancha?
questions.explanation: Zanjir qismi uchun Om qonuni: I = U/R = 10/20 = 0,5 A.

questions.question: Har biri 6 Ω dan bo'lgan ikkita qarshilik parallel ulangan. Ularning umumiy qarshiligi qancha?
questions.explanation: Parallel ulashda 1/R = 1/6 + 1/6 = 1/3, demak R = 3 Ω.

questions.question: Quvvati 100 W bo'lgan lampa 2 soat uzluksiz ishladi. U necha kVt·soat energiya sarfladi? Javobni son bilan yozing.
questions.explanation: A = Pt = 0,1 kVt · 2 soat = 0,2 kVt·soat.

questions.question: Sig'imi 2 mkF bo'lgan kondensator 100 V kuchlanishga ulandi. Uning zaryadi qancha?
Uzunligi 0,5 m o'tkazgichdan 4 A tok o'tmoqda. U magnit induksiyasi 0,2 Tl bo'lgan maydonga perpendikulyar joylashgan bo'lsa, Amper kuchi qancha?
questions.explanation: F = BIL sin α, α = 90° bo'lgani uchun F = 0,2·4·0,5 = 0,4 N.

questions.question: Faradey qonuniga ko'ra konturdagi induksiya elektr yurituvchi kuchi nimaga proporsional?
questions.explanation: Elektromagnit induksiya qonuni: EYK magnit oqimining vaqt bo'yicha o'zgarish tezligiga teng (ishorasi qarama-qarshi).

questions.question: Transformatorning birlamchi g'altagida 200, ikkilamchisida 50 ta o'ram bor. Birlamchi kuchlanish 220 V bo'lsa, ikkilamchi kuchlanish qancha?
questions.explanation: U2/U1 = N2/N1 = 50/200 = 1/4, demak U2 = 220/4 = 55 V (pasaytiruvchi transformator).

questions.question: Yorug'lik havodan suvga o'tganda nima ro'y beradi?

options.A: Tezligi kamayadi, sinish burchagi tushish burchagidan kichik bo'ladi
options.B: Tezligi ortadi, sinish burchagi tushish burchagidan katta bo'ladi

questions.explanation: Suv optik jihatdan zichroq muhit: n > 1, yorug'lik tezligi kamayadi va nur perpendikulyarga yaqinlashadi.

questions.question: To'la ichki qaytish qanday sharoitda ro'y beradi?

options.A: Yorug'lik optik zichroq muhitdan kamroq zich muhitga chegaraviy burchakdan katta burchak ostida tushganda
options.B: Yorug'lik kamroq zich muhitdan zichroq muhitga o'tganda

questions.explanation: Chegaraviy burchakdan katta burchakda singan nur yo'qoladi va yorug'lik butunlay qaytadi — optik tolali aloqa shu hodisaga asoslangan.

questions.question: Yig'uvchi linzaning fokus masofasi 0,2 m. Uning optik kuchi necha dioptriyaga teng? Javobni son bilan yozing.
questions.explanation: D = 1/F = 1/0,2 = 5 dptr. Yig'uvchi linzada optik kuch musbat.

questions.question: Yorug'lik interferensiyasi qanday to'lqinlar qo'shilganda kuzatiladi?

options.A: Kogerent, ya'ni chastotasi bir xil va fazalar farqi o'zgarmas to'lqinlar
options.B: Chastotasi turlicha bo'lgan har qanday to'lqinlar

questions.explanation: Barqaror maksimum va minimumlar hosil bo'lishi uchun to'lqinlar kogerent bo'lishi shart.

questions.question: Eynshteynning massa va energiya orasidagi bog'lanish formulasi qaysi?
questions.explanation: Tinchlikdagi energiya E = mc², bu yerda c — vakuumdagi yorug'lik tezligi.

questions.question: Fotoeffekt uchun Eynshteyn tenglamasi qaysi?
questions.explanation: Foton energiyasi chiqish ishiga va chiqarilgan elektronning maksimal kinetik energiyasiga sarflanadi.

questions.question: Chastotasi 5·10¹⁴ Hz bo'lgan foton energiyasi qancha? (h = 6,6·10⁻³⁴ J·s)
Uran-238 yadrosida nechta neytron bor? (Z = 92) Javobni son bilan yozing.
questions.explanation: N = A − Z = 238 − 92 = 146 neytron.

questions.question: Radioaktiv moddaning yarim yemirilish davri 5 kun. 20 kundan keyin boshlang'ich yadrolarning qancha qismi yemirilmay qoladi?
questions.explanation: 20 kun — 4 ta yarim yemirilish davri: (1/2)⁴ = 1/16.
